role_contracts.cover: Show the visual thesis and the deck's promise in one memorable first viewport.
role_contracts.proof: Show how this style handles evidence without losing hierarchy or readability.
role_contracts.system: Show how this style explains a workflow, mechanism, path, or loop.
role_contracts.closing: Show the final rule, decision, ask, or principle with a strong visual aftertaste.

starters.headline: Reveal the hidden layer
starters.support: A serious control-room cover: one thesis, one signal field, no decorative neon.
starters.visual: Dark diagnostic pane with a gold thesis marker and cyan signal trace.
starters.asset_direction: Dark technical atmosphere, quiet left thesis rail, right-side layered interface, no tiny terminal text.
qa: visual does not sit behind claim

starters.headline: Proof is a signal, not a screenshot pile
starters.support: Evidence pages use one table, one signal card, and a source footer.
starters.visual: Compact evidence table plus a glowing anomaly marker.
starters.asset_direction: Dark boardroom surface with reserved table zone and single cyan metric marker.

starters.headline: Detect, interpret, decide, act
starters.support: A mechanism slide should make the operating loop legible in three seconds.
starters.visual: Four-node loop over a hidden-layer grid.
starters.asset_direction: Layered control-room loop with four empty node plaques, away from claim rail.

starters.headline: Make the invisible operational
starters.support: The close returns to the thesis and leaves one action rule.
starters.visual: Gold decision seal over a dark evidence tray.
starters.asset_direction: Dark closing card with one gold seal and blank rule plaque.

starters.headline: One promise, staged clearly
starters.support: A launch cover gives the product or product moment room to breathe.
starters.visual: Hero product plinth with a precise light pool.
starters.asset_direction: Cinematic product stage, large empty title zone, no feature matrix.

starters.headline: Momentum belongs in three numbers
starters.support: Launch proof uses large metrics and tiny labels, not dense bullets.
starters.visual: Three product momentum counters with one customer quote strip.
starters.asset_direction: Minimal studio surface with three reserved metric slabs and one testimonial rail.

starters.headline: Show the click path, not the feature list
starters.support: A demo slide frames the product state, the action, and the outcome.
starters.visual: Product screen on a stage with three callout pins.
starters.asset_direction: High-fidelity product demo workbench with blank UI frame and callout safe zones.

starters.headline: Leave them with the product moment
starters.support: A keynote close should feel inevitable, not busy.
starters.visual: Centered product silhouette with final action rail.
starters.asset_direction: Cinematic closing frame, big quiet field, single call-to-action plaque.

starters.headline: The answer comes first
starters.support: A consulting cover states the recommendation before the supporting structure.
starters.visual: Precise grid with one blue decision path.
starters.asset_direction: Strict Swiss grid, white field, strong title rail, one blue decision line.

starters.headline: Every panel earns its place
starters.support: Dense executive pages need a grid with titles, states, and decisions.
starters.visual: Four-panel board grid with one highlighted risk.
starters.asset_direction: White executive grid, four evidence panels, one blue accent and one risk marker.

starters.headline: Name the bridge between current and target
starters.support: Strategy slides must show the mechanism that changes the state.
starters.visual: Before/after columns connected by an issue-tree bridge.
starters.asset_direction: Clean before-after comparison with a structured bridge region.

starters.headline: Decision required
starters.support: The final page names the call, owner, and next step.
starters.visual: Executive decision card with owner/date rail.
starters.asset_direction: Minimal decision page, large white card, blue rule, clear next-step strip.

starters.headline: The board packet starts with the variance
starters.support: Data desk style opens with the decision metric and its movement.
starters.visual: Dark KPI strip with one dominant variance marker.
starters.asset_direction: Dark data desk, tabular metric tiles, reserved annotation rail.

starters.headline: Explain the move before showing the chart
starters.support: A chart page needs a takeaway, source, and driver notes.
starters.visual: Line chart card with driver table and threshold marker.
starters.asset_direction: Board-review chart desk with one clear line chart and right-side driver notes.

starters.headline: Metric, driver, action, owner
starters.support: The operating system turns reporting into an action loop.
starters.visual: Four-stage operating loop around a central metric.
starters.asset_direction: Dark loop diagram with central metric tray and four action nodes.

starters.headline: Log the decision while it is still fresh
starters.support: The close converts the meeting into an accountable next action.
starters.visual: Decision log card with three rows.
starters.asset_direction: Dark closing log, one table card, clear action/owner/date columns.

starters.headline: Turn findings into an atlas
starters.support: Editorial research needs a strong finding, a human texture, and a map of evidence.
starters.visual: Magazine spread with annotated field map.
starters.asset_direction: Premium editorial spread, large quiet title margin, image crop with annotation room.

starters.headline: Evidence reads like a feature spread
starters.support: Proof pages combine source, quote, and implication.
starters.visual: Quote card plus small source table and annotated image crop.
starters.asset_direction: Editorial evidence page with quote zone, source rail, and image crop safe area.

starters.headline: Show how the pattern emerged
starters.support: Research systems need sequence, not a random list of observations.
starters.visual: Horizontal field timeline with three annotated moments.
starters.asset_direction: High-end magazine timeline, soft paper field, three evidence moments.

starters.headline: The implication is the memory
starters.support: Close with one implication and the evidence trail that supports it.
starters.visual: Large quote/rule card with small evidence trail.
starters.asset_direction: Editorial close, generous margins, one rule card and small citation trail.

starters.headline: Trust starts with restraint
starters.support: Clinical decks should feel careful, humane, and evidence-aware.
starters.visual: Soft protocol card with patient journey line.
starters.asset_direction: Calm clinical surface, quiet title field, soft journey object, no hype imagery.

starters.headline: Evidence needs a safety rail
starters.support: Clinical proof pages pair outcomes with risk and caveat notes.
starters.visual: Outcome table plus safety note card.
starters.asset_direction: Soft medical proof table, muted green accent, visible caveat/safety sidecard.

starters.headline: Screen, guide, monitor, escalate
starters.support: A care mechanism must show protocol order and handoff points.
starters.visual: Four-step care loop with one escalation branch.
starters.asset_direction: Humane clinical loop with blank care cards and clear escalation marker.

starters.headline: Move carefully, then measure
starters.support: The close defines the safe next step and the success measure.
starters.visual: Next-step protocol card with measurement strip.
starters.asset_direction: Calm close with one next-step card and conservative measurement strip.

starters.headline: Restraint is the signal
starters.support: Luxury decks use fewer objects, better spacing, and material proof.
starters.visual: Single hero object on a quiet material plane.
starters.asset_direction: Sparse premium material surface, one object, wide margins, no gold gradient.

starters.headline: Proof should whisper, not shout
starters.support: Use a small number of high-confidence figures with elegant captions.
starters.visual: Three sparse metric cards with a material swatch.
starters.asset_direction: Premium minimal metric page, cream surface, small gold accent, generous spacing.

starters.headline: Craft has a sequence
starters.support: Show process as a refined path from raw material to finished value.
starters.visual: Three-stage craft path with object detail crops.
starters.asset_direction: Elegant craft timeline, detail crops, thin rules, no clutter.

starters.headline: Leave one object in memory
starters.support: The close is a quiet decision card, not a fireworks page.
starters.visual: Hero object and final caption plaque.
starters.asset_direction: Minimal closing scene with one object, final line card, and material shadow.

starters.headline: Learn by moving pieces
starters.support: Training decks need progress, examples, mistakes, and a clear learner path.
starters.visual: Paper worksheet stage with tabs and practice cards.
starters.asset_direction: Warm paper workshop, blank worksheet cards, title-safe left field.

starters.headline: Examples beat abstractions
starters.support: A lesson proof slide should compare wrong, better, and why.
starters.visual: Worked-example table with a mistake sticker.
starters.asset_direction: Worksheet proof page, example table, red mistake note, green correction note.
qa: mistake and fix are both visible

starters.headline: Watch, try, compare, repeat
starters.support: Learning systems need the next learner action on every page.
starters.visual: Four-step practice path with checkpoint cards.
starters.asset_direction: Warm paper path with four blank checkpoint cards and progress lane.

starters.headline: The recap is a checklist
starters.support: Close with what the learner can now do, not a generic thank-you.
starters.visual: Checklist card with three completed items.
starters.asset_direction: Friendly recap page with checklist card and small practice prompt.

starters.headline: Say the thing they remember
starters.support: A manifesto cover needs a sharp enemy and a new belief.
starters.visual: Poster crop with one symbolic object.
starters.asset_direction: High-contrast poster stage, huge type-safe zone, one strong object, no cute icons.

starters.headline: Interrupt the poster with proof
starters.support: Use proof like a hard cut: one fact that earns the belief.
starters.visual: Single giant number plus proof caption.
starters.asset_direction: Poster proof page with one giant metric and stamped source rail.

starters.headline: Old belief, new behavior
starters.support: Manifesto systems should show the behavior shift, not a process manual.
starters.visual: Before/after poster split with a bold bridge word.
starters.asset_direction: High-contrast split poster, old/new zones, strong bridge label.

starters.headline: Make the ask unavoidable
starters.support: The close turns belief into action.
starters.visual: Final pledge card with one action button-like strip.
starters.asset_direction: Manifesto close, huge type, one pledge strip, no extra body copy.
qa: proof has appeared before the close

starters.headline: Show the buyer's workbench
starters.support: Sales decks start from the workflow the buyer recognizes.
starters.visual: Workbench UI area with before-state tasks.
starters.asset_direction: Clean SaaS workbench with blank product frame and recognizable task lane.

starters.headline: Tie proof to a workflow outcome
starters.support: Do not show generic logos; show time saved, errors reduced, or handoff improved.
starters.visual: Outcome table plus before/after metric chip.
starters.asset_direction: Product proof page with outcome table and single metric callout.

starters.headline: Click path becomes value path
starters.support: A demo path maps action to outcome in 4-5 visible steps.
starters.visual: Horizontal click path with callout pins.
starters.asset_direction: SaaS demo path, blank screen cards, five visible action nodes.

starters.headline: Next step: run the workflow live
starters.support: Close with a concrete demo or pilot ask.
starters.visual: Pilot checklist and calendar strip.
starters.asset_direction: Clean product close with pilot checklist, date rail, and CTA card.

starters.headline: A public decision needs public evidence
starters.support: Policy covers should name the community problem and accountable choice.
starters.visual: Map tile with program route and evidence markers.
starters.asset_direction: Institutional policy cover, map-safe visual, clear title rail, visible source/footer room.

starters.headline: Put the tradeoff on the page
starters.support: Policy proof needs beneficiaries, cost, risk, and accountability.
starters.visual: Evidence table with stakeholder impact card.
starters.asset_direction: Civic evidence table, stakeholder sidecard, restrained public-sector palette.

starters.headline: Fund, implement, measure, report
starters.support: The system page names the accountability loop.
starters.visual: Four-stage policy loop around a public dashboard card.
starters.asset_direction: Civic loop with public dashboard center and four accountable stages.

starters.headline: Approve the next accountable step
starters.support: Close with the decision, reporting cadence, and owner.
starters.visual: Approval card with reporting cadence strip.
starters.asset_direction: Policy closing page, approval card, owner/reporting strip, no decorative seal.

starters.headline: Build the campaign world
starters.support: Brand decks should make the world feel real before listing channels.
starters.visual: Moodboard stage with one big idea placard.
starters.asset_direction: Campaign-world cover, expressive but controlled, big title-safe zone.

starters.headline: Territories need criteria
starters.support: Creative proof compares audience fit, distinctiveness, and execution risk.
starters.visual: Three territory cards plus scoring strip.
starters.asset_direction: Brand territory grid with three distinct visual territories and scoring rail.

starters.headline: Idea to channel to proof
starters.support: Campaign systems show how the idea travels across formats.
starters.visual: Channel path with sample execution tiles.
starters.asset_direction: Campaign channel path, blank sample tiles, copy line strips.

starters.headline: Choose the world, then produce it
starters.support: The close locks the direction and names the first deliverables.
starters.visual: Creative direction card with deliverable strip.
starters.asset_direction: Campaign close with chosen-world card and first-deliverables strip.

starters.headline: Let the place explain itself
starters.support: Spatial decks need atmosphere, path, program, and proof.
starters.visual: Full-bleed place frame with a traced visitor route.
starters.asset_direction: Immersive place image with protected title field and visible route trace.

starters.headline: Program must meet proof
starters.support: Experience proof pairs zones with audience value and operations.
starters.visual: Zone proof table plus hero detail crop.
starters.asset_direction: Spatial proof spread, zone table on quiet surface, detail crop at side.

starters.headline: Arrival, reveal, dwell, return
starters.support: A spatial system is a visitor path with emotional beats.
starters.visual: Visitor path with four program moments.
starters.asset_direction: Route-map experience path with four moments and blank labels.

starters.headline: Make the next visit imaginable
starters.support: Close with the experience promise and the next production step.
starters.visual: Route card ending at a lit destination marker.
starters.asset_direction: Immersive closing scene, destination marker, quiet promise card.
